messages.content: Return one JSON object only, with no code fences, with "primary_topic", "topics" and "tracking_numbers". Topics: status_question, delay, return, damage, address_change, claim_followup, billing, other. Return tracking numbers as a plain list of strings exactly as written in the message.

Hello,

I received a power bank from Delta Gadgets yesterday, BYL260451265. The front is badly scratched and one of the USB ports is loose, I attached two photos. I don't want money for it, I just want to send it back and get a new one from the shop.

How do I arrange the return? I am in Mansoura.

Salma Youssef
